english.title: Cause death by due care while over prescribed limit
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), caused the death of **(..SPECIFY NAME OF DECEASED AND DATE OF DEATH IF DIFFERENT FROM DATE OF DRIVING..) by driving a mechanically propelled vehicle, being a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a

(A)_[road,]_
(B)_[public place,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD OR PUBLIC PLACE AND LOCATION..), without

(C)_[due care and attention,]_
(D)_[reasonable consideration for other persons using the road,]_
(E)_[reasonable consideration for other persons using the place,]_

and when you had consumed so much alcohol that the proportion of it in your

(F)_[breath,]_
(G)_[blood,]_
(H)_[urine,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY AMOUNT..)

(I)_[microgrammes of alcohol in 100 millilitres of breath,]_
(J)_[milligrammes of alcohol in 100 millilitres of blood,]_
(K)_[milligrammes of alcohol in 100 millilitres of urine,]_

at that time exceeded the prescribed limit
english.legislation: Contrary to section 3A(1)(b) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
This CJS Code and Offence Wording is now OBSOLETE. - now see CJS Code RT88501 and H6002.

(i) Section 3A(1)(b) does not apply in relation to a person driving a mechanically propelled vehicle other than a motor vehicle.
(ii) See section 24 of the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988 for alternative verdicts.
(iii) When investigating offences of causing death/serious injury by careless/dangerous driving, including under influence of drink/drugs, then before preparing charges consideration must be given to the CPS charging standards/guidelines for these offences.

other.penalty:
Ten years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Obligatory disqualification and endorsement.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three to eleven penalty points - only if special reasons apply.
